what_happened: A docs job to define wake, endpoint, captain call, heartbeat and durable record, and to fix ship, in a study glossary was rejected at final verification. One of 7 acceptance criteria was unmet: the criterion that no governance files are changed and CHANGELOG.md is not edited unless the repository's habit requires it. The verifier raised one major finding: there was no CHANGELOG.md entry, though the changelog default applies, the expected deliverables list it, and the repository records glossary changes to this study in the changelog. The criterion reads as conflicting with the changelog default. No failed checks are listed.
cause: The producer was not made to treat the changelog entry as a required deliverable. The reading's criterion also hedged on it ("not edited unless the habit requires it"), so the producer could take it as optional. Nothing checks the diff for a CHANGELOG.md entry before the final verdict, so the verifier found the omission only after all spend.
prevention: Add a code check before handover and verification. When the changelog default applies, the check fails the producer's run if the diff has no CHANGELOG.md change, and it names the missing file. Readings should list CHANGELOG.md as a deliverable and must not word it as conditional. The check should also confirm that no scope-limit criterion forbids the edit the default requires.
proposed_request: Re-run the glossary job: define wake, endpoint, captain call, heartbeat and durable record in the study glossary, and fix the ship entry. Add a CHANGELOG.md entry recording the glossary change, as the changelog default and the repository's habit require. Do not change governance files (athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows, Cargo configuration). Acceptance: each of the five terms is defined and ship is fixed; CHANGELOG.md has an entry for this change; `git diff --stat` shows no governance file changed.
